common.tagline: Fair pay. Safe work. Your voice.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.offline: You are offline. We will try again when you are connected.
common.tooMany: Too many tries. Please wait a minute.

landing.title: Decent work, made simple
landing.intro: One check-in counts your hours, overtime and pay. Report danger safely, even without your name.
landing.workerHint: Check in, see pay, report a problem
landing.sectors: Works for construction sites and college campus staff.

login.title: Worker login
login.speak: Enter your phone number and four digit PIN, then press Log in.

home.speak: Hello {name}. Today you worked {today} hours. This week {week} hours. Overtime {ot} hours.

fatigue.short_rest: Only {value} hours of rest between shifts (need {limit}).
fatigue.consecutive_days: You worked {value} days in a row (limit {limit}).

checkin.choose: How do you want to check in?
checkin.scanning: Point the camera at the site QR code.
checkin.confirmOut: Tap to end your work for today.
checkin.successIn: Work started at {time}. Have a safe day!
checkin.successOut: Work ended. You worked {hours} hours today.
checkin.speak: Scan the QR code at your site, or use your location to start work.

err.expired_qr: This QR code is old. Ask your supervisor for today's code.
err.bad_qr: This QR code is not a FairShift site code.
err.outside: You are {distance} metres away from {site}. Please go closer.
err.not_in: You have not started work yet.
err.gps_denied: Location is turned off. Allow location, or scan the QR code.
err.gps_unavailable: We could not find your location. Please scan the QR code.
err.camera_denied: Camera is turned off. Allow the camera, or use your location.
err.no_site: No work site found for you. Please tell your supervisor.

pay.title: My pay
pay.openShift: {count} shift has no end time and is not counted yet.

payslip.summary: From {start} to {end} you worked {days} days, {hours} hours in total.
payslip.summaryOpen: From {start} to {end} you worked {days} days, {hours} hours. {count} shift has no end time and is not counted yet.
payslip.regular: Normal pay: {hours} hours at {rate} per hour is {amount}.
payslip.ot: Overtime: {hours} extra hours were counted at {multiplier} times the rate, so {amount}.
payslip.noOt: You did no overtime in this period.
payslip.deductions: Cut from your pay: {items}. Total cut is {amount}.

report.title: Report a problem
report.speak: Choose what happened. Then hold the microphone button and speak. Your name is hidden unless you turn it on.
report.anonymousOn: Your name will NOT be shared.
report.anonymousOff: Your name will be shared with HR.
report.needText: Please record or type what happened.
report.micDenied: Microphone is turned off. Allow it, or type your report.
report.aiUnavailable: Voice to text is not available now. Please type instead.
report.tooLong: Voice note is too long. Keep it under 60 seconds.
report.doneIntro: This is your tracking code. Write it down. It is the only way to check this report.

track.title: Report status
track.notFound: No report found with this code.
track.anonymousNote: Your name is hidden. Only this code connects you to the report.

voice.title: My voice
voice.speak: How do you feel about work this week? Tap a face. Nobody will know your answer.
voice.pulseQ: How do you feel about work this week?
voice.pulseThanks: Thank you! Your answer is anonymous.
voice.pulseDone: You already answered this week. Thank you!

passport.title: My Skill Passport
passport.speak: Your skill passport shows {days} verified work days and {skills} skills.
passport.shareHint: Show this QR code or send the link to a new employer. Your phone number and wage are never shown.
passport.publicPrivacy: Contact details and wages are private.
